person.name: Roman Mednitzer
person.headline: Senior Systems & Platform Engineer
person.summary: I have around ten years of production infrastructure experience across managed services, enterprise infrastructure and a regulated medical-device environment.
person.description: Roman Mednitzer is a senior systems and platform engineer in Vienna, Austria, focused on infrastructure integration, reliable operations and recovery.
interests: Listening to industrial, EBM and dark ambient music
person.outlook: I like ambitious ideas and difficult problems, and I want room to question assumptions and change my mind. Open systems and digital sovereignty matter to me because I want to understand, adapt and retain control of the technology I use.
personalPerspective: I tend to follow a question across disciplines rather than stop where one field ends. AI, robotics and cybernetics interest me because they connect engineering with questions about intelligence, identity and how people might live. Human augmentation and space exploration appeal to the same curiosity: what could we become capable of, and what would it take to get there?

I like ambitious ideas and difficult problems, and I want room to question assumptions and change my mind. Open systems and digital sovereignty matter to me because I want to understand, adapt and retain control of the technology I use.
Hard science fiction gives me another way to explore those possibilities and their consequences. My musical tastes lean towards industrial, electronic body music (EBM) and dark ambient.

featuredProjects.name: relay-shell
featuredProjects.reasonFeatured: Connects AI clients to shell commands, SSH and interactive sessions through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), with operation records and configurable policy.
featuredProjects.boundary: Command restrictions are opt-in. The server runs with its service account’s permissions and does not provide a sandbox.

featuredProjects.name: osint-workbench
featuredProjects.reasonFeatured: A self-hostable workbench for collecting public information, retaining source evidence and searching the collected material. Optional AI processing and read-only access for AI assistants support further exploration.
featuredProjects.boundary: Experimental. Implemented workflows are tested in disposable environments; the complete system has not been validated for operational use.

interpretation.projectExperienceBoundary: These are personal, AI-assisted projects outside employment. I use AI substantially for implementation, testing and documentation. I define requirements, make integration decisions, review the results and validate their operation.
interpretation.interestPolicy: Technical interests describe areas of curiosity, not established specialist qualifications or professional research experience.

professionalWork.background: I have around ten years of production infrastructure experience across managed services, enterprise infrastructure and a regulated medical-device environment.
professionalWork.approach: I work with developers, operations, security teams and service owners to clarify requirements, integrate infrastructure and keep systems maintainable.

capabilities.description: I integrate Linux systems, virtualisation, storage and networking, including production environments using Kubernetes and OpenShift.
My work includes monitoring, incident analysis, controlled changes and backup administration, with documented restore tests and rollback planning.
I use Ansible and Terraform for infrastructure automation and write operational runbooks and handover documentation.

professionalWork.governanceSupport: My experience also includes supporting information security management, business continuity and preparation for ISO/IEC 27001 audits.

personalLab.description: In my private lab I explore AI infrastructure and automation, test integrations, and rehearse migrations and recovery. I also examine whether AI agents use command results correctly and remain consistent across longer tasks.
